(3) Clip to study area. (4) Validate against G21 station means. If lapse-rate IDW: (1) Use G21 station mean temperature values. (2) Correct to sea-level equivalent using station elevation and lapse rate. (3) Run IDW interpolation. (4) Apply DEM-based elevation correction (G09) to re-introduce terrain effect.
